topography.project_purpose: Gro is a yield optimization protocol that offers users exposure to stablecoin and DeFi yields through tokenized vault products. It provides both rebasing and non-rebasing tokens representing shares in yield-generating strategies.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Gro family integrates yield-bearing tokens (RebasingGToken, NonRebasingGToken) with staking contracts (LPTokenStaker) for the governance token (GROToken), while liquidity pools (UniswapV2Pair, WeightedPool) facilitate trading and deeper liquidity for the ecosystem.
